toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
The latency regression is almost certainly caused by the 2 Nov storage compaction tuning change, not gateway 5.8. That change raised compaction threads from 2 to 6. Disks went from 41% to 97% utilised within minutes of the push, and node-side GET time rose from 61 ms to 262 ms. In every cell, p99 jumped within minutes of the push, regardless of when 5.8 arrived. One cell, aps-3, got 5.8 but skipped the push, and its p99 stayed at about 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. Network and traffic growth don't fit the timing.

Do not roll back the gateway. It would not fix latency and would reopen the signature vulnerability, which audit requires closed by 30 Nov. Do not pause compaction fleet-wide: backlog would grow and disks would fill.

Next: revert the tuning in one cell first, watch p99 and backlog, then extend it to the others. Consider Orrin pacing later. The backlog is not yet attributed, and the projection shows no breach of 15% before 13 Nov. Confidence is high on the main cause, and moderate on backlog sources.
